title: How Can a Console Hold a City as Big as GTA 6's?

parts.text: Your console can't hold this whole city at once.
So how are you driving through it?
and each trick pushes this bar under the limit.
Anything outside your view isn't drawn.
Far buildings swap to simpler models, too small to notice.
Only the streets near you sit in memory.
The rest waits on the drive.
and streets load ahead while the ones behind get dropped.
because most of it isn't really there.
parts.tts: because most of it... isn't really there.

sources: Frustum culling: 'The objects outside of the camera's field of view (the view frustum) aren't visible, and can be culled'; 'Culled objects outside of the camera's view frustum are no longer rendered'. Epic Games, Unreal Engine 5 documentation, Visibility and Occlusion Culling, https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/visibility-and-occlusion-culling-in-unreal-engine

Level of detail: distant objects are drawn with simpler meshes whose difference is too small on screen to notice. Akenine-Moller, Haines, Hoffman et al., Real-Time Rendering, 4th ed. (CRC Press 2018), ch. 19.9 'Level of Detail'; Godot Engine docs, Optimizing 3D performance (Level of detail section).

Streaming: World Partition 'provides you with an automatic streaming system to load and unload those cells based on distance from a streaming source', 'such as the player'. Epic Games, Unreal Engine 5 documentation, World Partition, https://dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/world-partition-in-unreal-engine

Console memory is limited: PlayStation 5 has 16 GB of GDDR6 shared memory (Sony, Mark Cerny 'Road to PS5', 18 March 2020, reported by Gematsu https://www.gematsu.com/2020/03/ps5-technical-specifications-announced).

GTA 6 launch date 19 November 2026: Rockstar Newswire, https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/article/ak3ak31a49a221/grand-theft-auto-vi-is-now-set-to-launch-november-19-2026 (rechecked 2026-11-18). No claim is made about GTA 6's own engine; the video shows the general techniques with a simplified, original model city. The memory bar is illustrative, not measured.
